purpose.yaw_degrees: The raw top view puts the head toward -X/-Y. Rotate its approximate body axis to the shared +Y-front convention; retain the generated pose.
purpose.target_height_metres: Uniformly set the lowered-pose maximum height to the same 1.05 m comparison height as Meshy. This is not gameplay scale.
purpose.extra_views: Reuse the separately labelled lowered-head and underside cameras from the Meshy review.
